environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate task in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/24) within VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d4e. Subnet route table rt-0f9e8d7c6b has local route only (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry — no NAT Gateway, no Internet Gateway route, no VPC endpoint for S3 or any other AWS service. Network ACL acl-04a3b2c1d0 on the subnet has explicit DENY on all egress to 0.0.0.0/0 (rule 50, protocol -1, deny) before the default allow. Security group sg-0abc123def456 allows ingress only from internal ALB sg-0fed654cba321 on port 8080, egress rules allow only TCP 443 to 10.0.64.0/24 (internal service mesh sidecar). DNS resolution disabled for public domains via Route53 Resolver outbound endpoint with forwarding rule that drops non-.internal queries. Task execution role has no network-related permissions (no ec2:CreateNetworkInterface override). VPC Flow Logs enabled with rejection logging to CloudWatch.
